newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico assigns $300 mln in dollar put options.
newsitem.headline: Mexico assigns $300 mln in dollar put options.

text.p: Mexico's central bank said it had assigned all $300 million of put options offered at its monthly auction on Tuesday.
The options were assigned at a weighted premium of 13.75 pesos per $1,000, Banco de Mexico said.
This was the first auction since Banco de Mexico increased the amount on offer to $300 million from $200 million.
Mexico began selling dollar put options in August in order to boost foreign reserves.
